title: UniGenDet: Unified Generative-Discriminative Framework for Co-Evolutionary Image Generation and Detection
summary: UniGenDet is a closed-loop architecture that bridges image generation and AI-generated image detection. It enables the generator and detector to evolve synchronously, using generative priors to enhance detection robustness and detector feedback to improve image realism.
research_notes: Developed by researchers from Tsinghua University; weights are hosted on Hugging Face under the Yanran21 organization.

evolution.summary: The project was accepted to CVPR 2026 and represents a shift from adversarial 'arms races' to co-evolutionary models. It is built upon the BAGEL-7B-MoT architecture and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in cross-generator detection generalization.
